description: In crates/core/src/audit.rs flush_buffer, SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_millis() returns u128, then cast to i64 with 'as i64'. This cast silently truncates for timestamps beyond year 2262 (when millis exceed i64::MAX). The pattern mirrors the HLC timestamp guard added in sqlite_storage.rs but is missing here. Fix: use i64::try_from(...).map_err(...) and propagate the error, matching the pattern in group_log/sqlite_storage.rs lines 39-44.
title: audit flush_buffer: as_millis() as i64 silently truncates post-2262 timestamps
